why: webhook trigger setup is well covered in the docs
subject: How do I create a webhook trigger in a Zap?
body: I'm on the free plan and want my Zap to run when my app POSTs to a URL. How do I get the webhook URL and test it?
expected_output: Points to Catch Hook / webhook trigger in the Zap editor, how to copy the custom webhook URL, and how to send a test payload to populate sample data.

subject: Setting up API key authentication for my integration
body: Where do I configure an API key auth scheme in the Zapier Platform UI and how is it sent on requests?
expected_output: Explains choosing API Key auth in the Platform UI, adding the key input field, and wiring it into request headers/params via a computed field or the auth mapping.

subject: How do I add OAuth v2 to my integration?
body: I need to implement the OAuth2 authorization code flow for my app in the platform UI.
expected_output: Walks through selecting OAuth v2, setting the authorization URL, access-token URL, scope, and the test request.

subject: How do I test my trigger returns sample data?
body: My polling trigger isn't showing sample data in the editor. How should I test it?
expected_output: Explains running a test from the trigger's Test step, needing at least one real record to exist, and using the pulled record as sample data.

why: dedup for polling triggers is documented
subject: How does deduplication work for polling triggers?
body: Why is my polling trigger firing repeatedly for the same record? How is the id used?
expected_output: Explains that Zapier dedupes on the id field of each returned object, so id must be stable and unique; unstable ids cause repeated triggering.

subject: How do I handle pagination in a trigger?
body: My REST API paginates results. How do I page through them in a Zapier trigger?
expected_output: Describes using bundle.meta.page in a polling trigger to request successive pages, keeping newest-first ordering.

subject: My action hits the 30-second timeout
body: A slow downstream API makes my action time out. What are the options - async, polling?
expected_output: Explains the ~30s synchronous limit and the callback/polling (z.generateCallbackUrl / performResume) pattern for long-running work.

subject: How do I deprecate an old integration version?
body: I want to sunset v1 of my integration and move users to v2. What's the process?
expected_output: Describes the CLI migrate command to move users between versions and the deprecate command with a date to warn remaining users.

subject: What are the throttle types for API, webhook and polling?
body: I keep hitting throttles. What limits apply to each request type and how do I back off?
expected_output: Explains the per-type throttles and that a 429 with Retry-After should be respected; Zapier auto-retries held tasks.

why: computed fields / session auth is documented
subject: How do computed fields work with session auth?
body: I have a session auth scheme and need some fields computed after auth. How?
expected_output: Explains marking auth fields computed:true so they are populated by the sessionConfig/getSessionKey response rather than entered by the user.

why: consumer billing / proration is NOT in the developer-docs corpus - the draft must not invent a proration answer
subject: Unexpected charge after mid-cycle plan upgrade
body: We moved from Team to Professional on the 12th and were billed the full amount, not prorated. Is this invoice correct?
expected_output: Should NOT assert whether the invoice is correct or explain proration mechanics from nothing; should acknowledge it needs a billing specialist / human review.

why: refund policy is account/policy, not docs - the draft must not promise or deny a refund
subject: Requesting a refund for last month
body: We were charged for a plan we stopped using. Can you refund the last billing cycle?
expected_output: Should not commit to issuing or refusing a refund; should route to a human who can review the account.

why: SOC 2 / compliance posture is not answerable from the dev docs - no invented compliance claims
subject: Is Zapier MCP SOC 2 compliant?
body: Our security team needs to know the compliance posture and how access is controlled for MCP before we adopt it.
expected_output: Should not fabricate a compliance statement; should defer to the security/trust team or point to an authoritative source it actually has.

why: pricing negotiation is commercial, not docs - no invented discount
subject: Can we get a discount on the Team plan?
body: We're a small non-profit. Is there any discount available on the Team plan pricing?
expected_output: Should not invent a discount amount or eligibility rule; should hand to sales / a human.
